title: Ignition Derived Tag
description: JSON schema for Ignition Derived Tag based on actual project examples

name.description: Tag name (letters, digits, underscores, spaces, parentheses, single quotes, dashes, colons; <256 chars)

sourceTagPath.description: Path to the source tag this derived tag references

deriveExpressionGetter.description: Expression to transform the source value on read

deriveExpressionSetter.description: Expression to transform the written value before sending to source

preserveSourceTimestamp.description: If true, use timestamp from source value

enabled.description: Whether tag is evaluated by the Tag Group

tagGroup.description: Tag Group that will execute the tag

tooltip.description: Tooltip text shown on hover in visual components

historyEnabled.description: Whether tag reports to Tag Historian

alarmEvalEnabled.description: Determines if alarms will be evaluated on this tag
